rules: The frozen symbol ledger remains the only symbol-level classification record.
Cohort membership never implies a compatibility classification.
A symbol changes from UNASSESSED only with linked structural or behavioral evidence.
No difficult method or external public type may be silently omitted.

existing_structural_slice.scope: Gate A plus completed Phase 13 slices; only symbols classified in the canonical ledger carry a compatibility claim

cohorts.objective: Complete the player, event, track, marker, and frame contract around the proven Gate A slice.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Per-symbol ledger entries, generated class structure, Revapi diff, and behavioral oracle coverage.

cohorts.objective: Expand source SPI, built-in manager shells, class lookup, and serialization-visible types.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Source SPI extension tests, source lookup tests, per-symbol ledger entries, and Revapi diff.

cohorts.objective: Cover filter factories, extension classes, PCM filters, and audio format contracts.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Filter extension/identity tests, format behavior tests, per-symbol ledger entries, and Revapi diff.

cohorts.objective: Cover public container, probe, seek, and media-facing extension contracts.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Container fixtures, protected-extension tests, per-symbol ledger entries, and Revapi diff.

cohorts.objective: Cover public utilities, HTTP configuration surfaces, scheduling, and exception behavior.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Utility/HTTP behavioral tests, external-type resolution, per-symbol ledger entries, and Revapi diff.

cohorts.objective: Classify the legacy native surface explicitly without inheriting obsolete implementation choices.
cohorts.exit_evidence: Explicit legacy/unsupported decisions or tests for every symbol, plus the applicable Revapi diff.

packaging_constraints: Preserve required resources and metadata deliberately rather than copying the reference artifact wholesale.
Resolve Java 25+ native-access packaging before claiming future-JDK support.
Generate JVM artifacts without committed Java or Kotlin source.

phase_entry.precondition: The complete Phase 12 live-service policy has passed, with replay-only credential-gated integrations documented explicitly.
phase_entry.phase_exit: No unexplained Revapi or binary structural difference remains in A_EXACT scope.
